svg.title: Process engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as process engineer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: An opposing-triangle process valve lies in a horizontal pipe beneath a separate gauge branch. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
